receipt.sql: WITH spend AS (SELECT ts, advertiser_id, country, SUM(ad_spend) AS spend FROM fact_ads_hourly WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-21 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-21 03:00:00' AND country IN ('DE', 'FR') GROUP BY ts, advertiser_id, country), plan AS (SELECT ts, advertiser_id, country, planned_spend FROM fact_ad_plan_hourly WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-21 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-21 03:00:00' AND country IN ('DE', 'FR')) SELECT plan.ts, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(spend.spend, 0)), 2) AS spend, ROUND(SUM(plan.planned_spend), 2) AS planned FROM plan LEFT JOIN spend USING (ts, advertiser_id, country) GROUP BY plan.ts ORDER BY plan.ts

SELECT ts, advertiser_id, country, platform, ad_impressions, ad_clicks, ad_spend, ad_conversions, attributed_gmv FROM fact_ads_hourly WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-21 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-21 03:00:00' AND country NOT IN ('DE', 'FR') ORDER BY ts, advertiser_id, country, platform
